brief: 2026 India-oriented P-series long-endurance and light-entertainment variants
reference_role: directional evidence only; no reference image was passed to generation

outputs.name: Upper Power Deck
visible_evidence: two real cameras and one pill flash form a clear horizontal hierarchy
the wide upper deck and layered lower edge create strong P-series retail recognition
dual views share a coherent graphite soft-square chassis and neutral front
limitations: the deck stops short of the requested bilateral side-rail attachment
the layered setback reads more as generic industrial fins than a specific restrained cultural relationship
outputs.next_step: keep the broad deck but make one real frame attachment and reduce the lower edge to two cleaner structural steps

outputs.name: Endurance Spine
outputs.first_failed_rule: Phone Base Contract 0.1.3 section 5 — Camera Architecture
visible_evidence: the red flush spine creates the strongest P-series family resemblance
the two real lenses retain clear descending hierarchy
an unexplained extra black rounded aperture appears directly below the flash
limitations: the extra black aperture is pseudo-hardware and forces rejection
the vertical field breaks into several large tonal blocks rather than the requested gradual depth shift
outputs.next_step: remove the extra aperture and simplify the spine to one continuous flush depth field

outputs.name: Twin Ring Field
visible_evidence: two independent real rings and one flash remain honest and immediately legible
the narrow connecting bridge avoids a generic black camera island
olive CMF and rigid micro-grooves are coherent across the rear and frame
limitations: the laser texture expands across the full upper half instead of staying near the camera footprint
the quiet premium treatment weakens the intended energetic P-series character
outputs.next_step: confine the grooves to a smaller bounded functional field and restore one stronger value-oriented structural cue

outputs.name: Frame-Fed Saddle
visible_evidence: the unequal horizontal lens pair and pill flash have clean hierarchy
the saddle, layered shoulder and left frame read as one camera-to-chassis system
silver phone separates strongly from the dark indigo background and both views remain consistent
limitations: the shoulder uses more concentric layers than the restrained three-setback intent
the result reads closer to upper-mainstream imaging than affordable endurance entertainment
outputs.next_step: keep the tangent frame relationship but simplify the shoulder and reduce premium metal signalling

verdict: three pass, one reject; retain every image and do not auto-regenerate
schema_learning: Schema 1.4.0 supports visibly distinct P-series directions while preserving mature form, topology originality and bounded process intent. Generation still tends to invent pseudo-hardware in dense camera courts and to over-expand or over-layer process carriers. Stronger prompt repetition may be needed for exact functional-element count and one bounded carrier, but no Schema change is promoted from this batch alone.
